name: Cama de solteiro
prompt: Create ONE single medieval oak bed sprite for a VTT battlemap, one cream pillow and an olive green quilt, a narrow oak frame. STRICT ARCHITECTURAL PLAN VIEW, true orthographic projection from a camera DIRECTLY VERTICALLY ABOVE, 90 degrees to the floor, no camera tilt. The mattress is a clean long RECTANGLE with exactly parallel edges, long axis north-south and pillow at the TOP. Only top surfaces of the mattress, pillow, rails and a thin headboard edge are visible. Headboard is ONLY a thin line along the north edge, never a tall panel. No vertical front or side faces, footboard face, visible legs, elevation, trapezoidal perspective, isometric angle or background floor. Realistic detailed hand-painted fantasy battlemat art, natural worn oak and linen texture, coherent human scale 1 by 2 five-foot cells. Genuine transparent alpha around the complete object and tiny contact shadow. Centered, no cropped edges, no room, floor tile, people, text, signature, watermark or frame.
